{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now compute the mean of biomarker_final, in ng/mL
# Note: assay_batch B reports in µg/L, which is 10× larger than ng/mL. So divide batch B values by 10.
# First, check which batch has which values
df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
# Apply correction only to batch B
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'] = df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] / 10

# Compute the mean of the corrected biomarker_final
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()

print(f"Number of patients after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}")
print(f"Mean biomarker_final (corrected to ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final}")"}
